question: On a real primitive family independent of the activation design/stabilization work, can the frozen execution_ready model reproduce evidence-faithful routing, readiness, residency, acquisition and lifecycle semantics without changing the generic abstraction, adding an activation state machine, inventing science, or adding a family-specific policy branch?

holdout_oracle.control_binding: ANL64 preferred execution is ready only when the exact model is loaded, the immutable hashed plan is valid, and the bound Q4_FAST executor path is ready.
holdout_oracle.representation: The 593504-byte plan is shared static control-plane metadata, not a separately acquired per-request primitive representation; existing model weight residency is retained unchanged.
holdout_oracle.acquisition: No request-time acquisition action exists. Plan construction occurs at model load and no per-token executor discovery, payload repack, prefetch pass or additional weight copy is permitted.
holdout_oracle.fallback: Existing semantics-preserving Q4 safe executor path.
holdout_oracle.lifecycle: No independent request-time representation lifetime policy is evidenced for Q4_FAST; the holdout must not invent ACQUIRE/EVICT actions for plan metadata.
holdout_oracle.inside_evidence_scope_plan_invalid_or_q4: ROUTE_SAFE_FALLBACK if fallback ready; otherwise NOT_READY/no route
holdout_oracle.outside_holdout_evidence_scope: Do not route ANL64 preferred; use independently validated safe fallback only if ready

falsification_conditions: ANL64 requires treating plan metadata as a fake request-time acquired representation.
ANL64 requires an invented ACQUIRE or EVICT lifecycle action.
ANL64 preferred route cannot be expressed as execution_ready gated by plan validity plus executor readiness.
Correct behavior requires testing ANL64 family identity inside the generic policy.
A new activation enum/state machine is required.
